description: This file defines the LeaveRequestService class in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It manages leave request workflows, status changes, permissions, and event dispatching related to leave requests and leaves, including allowed actions, changing leave statuses, and retrieving detailed leave data.

classes.name: LeaveRequestService
classes.description: Service class managing the lifecycle, workflow, permissions, status transitions, and detailed retrieval of leave requests within the OrangeHRM system. Implements methods to handle leave status changes, enforce workflow actions, and aggregate leave data.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeaveRequestDao instance used for database interactions related to leave requests.

methods.name: _changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of multiple leaves, handling linked entitlement adjustments and skipping weekends or holidays.

methods.name: _notifyLeaveStatusChange
methods.description: Dispatches appropriate events based on the change in leave statuses, such as approval, cancellation, or rejection.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves permissible workflow actions for a specific employee, leave type, and leave status, considering employee roles and permissions.

methods.name: isLeaveRequestActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a specific action is permitted for an employee on a leave request based on roles and current workflow state.

methods.name: generateIncludeRolesForLeaveWorkflowByEmployee
methods.description: Determines which roles to include based on whether the employee is acting on their own leave request.

methods.name: generateLeaveStatusByLeaveType
methods.description: Prepends a prefix to the leave status if the associated leave type has been deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestActions
methods.description: Returns a list of actions available for a specific leave request based on current workflow options.

methods.name: changeLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a leave request and dispatches related events.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of a single leave and triggers event dispatching.

methods.name: changeLeavesStatus
methods.description: Changes the status for multiple leaves, grouping by leave request, and dispatches events accordingly.

methods.name: groupLeaves
methods.description: Groups leaves by their associated leave request ID.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Constructs detailed leave request objects including all associated leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of leave request IDs to leave request objects for quick lookup.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Lazy-loads and returns an associative array mapping leave status codes to their names.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a leave status given its numerical code.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Retrieves the numerical code corresponding to a leave status name.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusesByNames
methods.description: Converts an array of leave status names into their corresponding codes.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Returns detailed leave objects with all related leaves included.
